facts.fact: Minister Edna Oliveira cited Cabo Verde's electronic public procurement platform as a transparency measure showing criteria and processes for awarding public contracts.

CPV.note: The Administrative Procedure Code consultation is not said to be online; E-participa takes complaints and suggestions on services, not drafts.

facts.fact: Minister Edna Oliveira said the E-participa platform lets citizens submit complaints, reports and suggestions on the conduct of public services; no case figures given.

CPV.note: Nothing on local government office connection.
Mentions an access and reuse law and an open data commitment in the OGP plan, but no data published for download or licence stated.
Only consultation named is on the Administrative Procedure Code, not a digital law or policy.
